name: mirage
text: v1.0.113 is out: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.113 . It saves your 10 MB bet history at most every 4 s instead of on every change, deletes the 13 MB OddsPapi cache, and stops reading the bid file while the engine posts bids. OddsPapi is off on the engine. Not done: the 9.4 s cold start (needs a deeper change, logged as DG1b), and a full code removal of OddsPapi. The ParlayAPI key ending 10d2 is the phone's own free key. Paste your Business key in Settings > APIs > ParlayAPI and the app sends it to GitHub. The engine's own ParlayAPI feed is healthy, 40 books streaming. I found no TLS or DNS errors on the engine, so those come from your phone's connection.
